name: Zippolt
look: a polished chrome flip-top lighter with its lid open over a chimney and flame, spark eyes and little steel legs
entry: Celebrated for its signature metallic clink, Zippolt can keep its tiny flame alive even in the middle of a fierce gale.
how: Wild: uncommon in the Ashtray Wastes (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto).
It learns Flint Snap at level 17.
